G700.et: probably from (142) (through the idea of exciting emotion)
G700.def: probably from «142» (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so):--please.

G701.def: from «700»; agreeable; by implication, fit:--(things that) please(-ing), reason.

G702.def: of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian:--Aretas.

G703.def: from the same as «730»; properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed):--praise, virtue.

G704.def: perhaps the same as «730»; a lamb (as a male):--lamb.

G707.def: of Hebrew origin («07414»); Arimathaea (or Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Arimathaea.

G708.def: from the same as «712» and «757»; best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian:--Aristarchus.

G709.def: from «712»; to take the principle meal:--dine.

G710.et: apparently a comparative of the same as (712)
G710.def: apparently a comparative of the same as «712»; the left hand (as second-best):--left (hand).

G711.def: from the same as «712» and «1012»; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian:--Aristobulus.

G712.et: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as (730)
G712.def: apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as «730»; the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from eri ("early")), i.e. luncheon:--dinner.

G714.et: apparently a primary word [but probably akin to (142) through the idea of raising a barrier]
G714.def: apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to «142» through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory):--be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.

G715.def: probably from «714»; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity):--bear.

G716.et: probably from (1)42">142) [perhaps with 1 (as a particle of union) prefixed]
G716.def: probably from «142» (perhaps with «1» (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare «719»)):--chariot.

G717.def: of Hebrew origin (2022 and «04023»); Armageddon (or Har-Meggiddon), a symbolic name:--Armageddon.

G718.def: from «719»; to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth):--espouse.

G719.def: from the same as «716»; an articulation (of the body):--joint.

G720.et: perhaps from (1) (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of (4483)
G720.def: perhaps from «1» (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of «4483»; to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate:--deny, refuse.

G726.def: from a derivative of «138»; to seize (in various applications):--catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).

G728.def: of Hebrew origin («06162»); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest:--earnest.

G729.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as (4476)
G729.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as «4476»; unsewed, i.e. of a single piece:--without seam.

G730.def: probably from «142»; male (as stronger for lifting):--male, man.

G731.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the same as (4490)
G731.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the same as «4490»; unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible:--unspeakable.

G732.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4517)
G732.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4517»; infirm:--sick (folk, -ly).

G733.def: from «730» and «2845»; a sodomite:--abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.

G734.et: contracted from a compound of (735) and (1435)
G734.def: contracted from a compound of «735» and «1435»; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian:--Artemas.

G735.def: probably from the same as «736»; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities:--Diana.

G736.def: from a derivative of «737»; properly, something ready (or else more remotely from «142» (compare «740»); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel:--mainsail.

G737.et: from a derivative of (142) (cf (740)) through the idea of suspension
G737.def: adverb from a derivative of «142» (compare «740») through the idea of suspension; just now:--this day (hour), hence(-forth), here(-after), hither(-to), (even) now, (this) present.

G738.def: from «737» and «1084»; just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert:--new born.

G740.def: from «142»; bread (as raised) or a loaf:--(shew-)bread, loaf.

G741.def: from a presumed derivative of «142»; to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments):--season.

G742.def: of Hebrew origin («0775»); Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch:--Arphaxad.

G744.def: from «746»; original or primeval:--(them of) old (time).

G745.def: from «757» and «2994»; people-ruling; Archelaus, a Jewish king:--Archelaus.

G746.def: from «756»; (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank):--beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.

G747.def: from «746» and «71»; a chief leader:--author, captain, prince.

G748.def: from «746» and a derivative of «2413»; high-priestly:--of the high-priest.

G749.def: from «746» and «2409»; the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest:--chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.

G750.def: from «746» and «4166»; a head shepherd:--chief shepherd.

G751.def: from «746» and «2462»; horse-ruler; Archippus, a Christian:--Archippus.

G752.def: from «746» and «4864»; director of the synagogue services:--(chief) ruler of the synagogue.

G753.def: from «746» and «5045»; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect":--masterbuilder.

G754.def: from «746» and «5057»; a principle tax-gatherer:--chief among the publicans.

G755.et: from (746) and a compound of (5140) and (2827) (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches)
G755.def: from «746» and a compound of «5140» and «2827» (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment:--governor (ruler) of the feast.

G756.et: middle voice of (757) (through the implication of precedence)
G756.def: middle voice of «757» (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time):--(rehearse from the) begin(-ning).

G757.def: a primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power):--reign (rule) over.

G758.def: present participle of «757»; a first (in rank or power):--chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.

G759.et: from (142) (in the sense of sending off scent)
G759.def: from «142» (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic:--(sweet) spice.

G760.def: of Hebrew origin («0609»); Asa, an Israelite:--Asa.

G761.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4531)
G761.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4531»; unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively):--which cannot be moved, unmovable.

G762.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4570)
G762.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4570»; not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--not to be quenched, unquenchable.

G764.def: from «765»; to be (by implied act) impious or wicked:--commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.

G765.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4576)
G765.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4576»; irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked:-- ungodly (man).

G766.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed selges (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent)
G766.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed selges (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices):--filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.

G767.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the base of (4591)
G767.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the base of «4591»; unmarked, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble:--mean.

G768.def: of Hebrew origin («0836»); Aser (i.e. Asher), an Israelite tribe:--Aser.

G769.def: from «772»; feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty:--disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.

G770.def: from «772»; to be feeble (in any sense):--be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.

G772.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the base of (4599)
G772.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the base of «4599»; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral):--more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).

G773.def: of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore:--Asia.

G774.def: from «773»; an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia:--of Asia.

G775.def: from «773» and «746»; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor:--chief of Asia.

G777.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4621»; without (taking) food:--fasting.

G778.def: probably from the same as «4632»; to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive):--exercise.

G779.def: from the same as «778»; a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle:--bottle.

G780.et: from a derivative of the base of (2237)
G780.def: adverb from a derivative of the base of «2237»; with pleasure:--gladly.

G781.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4680»; unwise:--fool.

G782.et: from (1) (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of (4685)
G782.def: from «1» (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of «4685»; to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome:--embrace, greet, salute, take leave.

G783.def: from «782»; a greeting (in person or by letter):--greeting, salutation.

G784.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «4695»; unblemished (physically or morally):--without spot, unspotted.

G785.def: of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp":--asp.

G786.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4689)
G786.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4689»; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless:--implacable, truce-breaker.

G787.def: of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin:--farthing.

G788.et: neuter comparative of the base of (1451)
G788.def: neuter comparative of the base of «1451»; more nearly, i.e. very near:--close.

G789.def: probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor:--Assos.

G790.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2476)
G790.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2476»; to be non-stationary, i.e. (figuratively) homeless:--have no certain dwelling-place.

G791.def: from astu (a city); urbane, i.e. (by implication) handsome:--fair.

G792.def: probably from the base of «4766»; a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively:--star.

G793.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (4741)
G793.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «4741»; unfixed, i.e. (figuratively) vacillating:--unstable.

G794.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of stergo (to cherish affectionately)
G794.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of stergo (to cherish affectionately); hard-hearted towards kindred:--without natural affection.

G795.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and stoichos (an aim)
G795.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and stoichos (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth:--err, swerve.

G796.def: from «797»; lightning; by analogy, glare:--lightning, bright shining.

G797.def: probably from «792»; to flash as lightning:--lighten, shine.

G798.def: neuter from «792»; properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial):--star.

G799.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (4793)
G799.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «4793»; incomparable; Asyncritus, a Christian:--Asyncritos.
